card.name: The word known before a condition
card.fires_on: The word "known" (or similar words like "suspected") right after "patients with" and before a hypersensitivity or risk condition. It also fires on the end of a number of years, as in "150 years ago".

modes.label: Known/suspected before condition
modes.description: Hedging word after "patients with" or "drugs", leading into a named condition or cause.

modes.label: Years-ago numbers
modes.description: Last digit or the word years in a large number of years before "ago".
modes.example: Confederate President Jefferson Davis, beset by recent military setbacks, orders a major Cabinet reshuffle this week 150<< years>> ago in the Civil War.
